bookingOpens: Online through TheFork from the restaurant's website (separate pages for the main room and the Parallels private room), or by phone or email. A credit card is needed, but nothing is charged when booking.
cancellation: Free to cancel or change up to 48 hours before, by email only (info@ristoranteilpagliaccio.com). Later cancellations, no-shows and fewer guests than booked are charged €200 a person.
groups: The Parallels private room takes up to six guests, with its own 10-course menu (€330) and service. Small dogs are allowed only there, once the booking office confirms.
dressCode: No strict dress code. Smart casual at lunch and elegant casual at dinner; no shorts, flip-flops, T-shirts or trainers.
children: Children over 5 are welcome. Mention younger children when booking; the restaurant decides whether to accept them.
